\pgfplotstableset{col sep=comma}
\begin{tikzpicture}

  \addplot[blue!70!black, thick, const plot mark right] table[x=t, y=pos] {\EFourData/lead/home_double_s.csv};

  \addplot[green!50!black, densely dotted, thick, const plot mark right] table[x=t, y=vel] {\EFourData/lead/home_ruckig.csv};
